newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian analysts query Olivetti on books.
newsitem.headline: Italian analysts query Olivetti on books.

text.p: The association of Italian financial analysts AIAF said it had put seven questions to troubled high-tech group Olivetti about its accounts ahead of the company's meeting with Milan analysts next Monday.
Olivetti's board and auditors were meeting stock market watchdog authority Consob on Thursday afternoon to try to iron out the seven points, which Consob itself wants answered.

AIAF said in a statement it wanted answers on Olivetti's plans and costing for its future operating activities, details of its inventories and contracts with suppliers, figures on the company's outstanding credits, details on its factoring arrangements, future borrowing needs and full information on the accounts of Olivetti's five operating companies.
